report.summary: Audited frozen change fd010a03→d3cb1e0e (17 paths, ~1,376 diff lines) implementing the operational report audit plan. The core design is sound and matches milestones 1–5: observations are run-identity-bound with per-row content hashes; scoring is deterministic with explicit reason codes where source severity is never rating authority; critical findings outweigh passes; Unrated is distinct from 2/5; stale/malformed or foreign-run observations cap the score at 2/5, blocking a different or interrupted run from borrowing a passing result. Export binding uses a destination lock, strict write-and-read-back verification, digest-suffixed companion filenames for reused folders, Unrated-with-no-stale-link on audit-only failure, and propagation of required write failures; both renderers end with the required footer and tests parse actual artifacts including concurrency, Markdown-only, direct-render and reused-folder cases, and assert no private exception text leaks. Material issues: (1) VendorNotConfiguredError skips are counted as vendor failures, so an intentional configuration skip grades a run 4/5 (or 3/5 on exhaustion), contradicting the plan's rule that intentional skips do not lower the score; (2) structured-output exhaustion falling back to free text is recorded as model_retry_recovered (5/5, invisible) rather than fallback_recovered (4/5), making exhausted recovery indistinguishable from a clean run; (3) direct HTML render claims Report integrity "verified" without performing any export/publication check; (4) milestone-2 verify items (truncation capture, partial restart, second independent run through the real graph) are not evidenced by tests in the frozen diff; (5) latent risk that the observation reducer's ValueError could abort a live run if identity inputs ever vary mid-run; (6) milestones 6–7 (independent audit, visual/portable inspection, closure) are open at head, as the acceptance record itself discloses — this review presumably serves as that pending independent audit. No critical or high-severity defects found; publication integrity, decisions, and historical records are untouched by the new observation fields in the diff.
limitations: Audit was restricted to the frozen request.json diff and requirements; unchanged files it depends on (evidence_snapshot allowlist, dataflows.files.locked/replace_file, resolve_summary, cli/run.py, publication verification internals) could not be inspected, so claims like 'operational_observations excluded from publication identity' rest on the acceptance document, not direct evidence.

Test and lint results cited in the acceptance record (3,032-test default suite, Ruff, git diff --check) were not independently reproduced; no commands were run against the repository per the no-write/no-install constraint.

ContextVar propagation of the capture context into threaded tool execution under LangGraph/LangChain could not be verified from the diff alone; a propagation gap would silently drop tool-level observations rather than corrupt them.
Coverage of sentiment prefetch and any acquisition occurring outside observed graph nodes could not be confirmed; record_operation is a silent no-op outside an active node context.
Representative synthetic exports referenced by the plan's milestone 6 were not part of the frozen manifest, so artifact-level visual/portable-folder inspection was not possible.

findings.title: Intentional vendor-configuration skip lowers operational score: VendorNotConfiguredError is counted in failed_vendors, grading a successful fallback 4/5 (vendor_fallback_recovered) and an unconfigured chain 3/5 (vendor_unavailable), contradicting the plan rule that an intentional skip does not lower the score

Structured-output exhaustion with free-text fallback recorded as model_retry_recovered (5/5, produces no finding) instead of fallback_recovered (4/5), making exhausted recovery indistinguishable from a clean run despite the plan requiring that distinction

Direct HTML render reports Report integrity as 'verified' for states without a publication record although no export or publication check runs on that path; plan requires observed results or explicit unknown/not-applicable per rating input

Milestone-2 verify items not evidenced in frozen diff tests: no test exercises model_output_truncated capture, checkpoint partial-restart observation carryover, or a second independent same-ticker/date run through the real graph (identity rejection covered only at unit level)

Latent run-abort risk: merge_observations/observation raise ValueError during live graph state reduction on identity or digest inconsistency (e.g., run_settings mutated mid-run), so an audit-only feature could crash a real run; no current trigger visible in diff

Goal not closed at head: independent Claude audit, visual/portable-folder inspection and closure (milestones 6–7) remain pending, as honestly disclosed in the acceptance record; this review presumably constitutes the pending independent audit
